title: Let athena retry accept a stale job and re-verify its merged candidate
summary: Retry of job 20261106-141829-5g4b (dispatched, never verified, no findings, no candidate): redo the work from the base. `athena retry` on a stale job merges the kept candidate onto the branch tip. A clean merge is re-checked, re-verified and landed with no producer call. A conflict goes to a producer retry from the candidate. Audience: users running parallel jobs, and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass, with new tests for the clean-merge and conflict paths.
Each behavior criterion names a test that shows the retry, re-verification and landing happening.
The new decision and the CHANGELOG entry are written for an outside reader.
The criteria check that the merged tree is re-verified and that the verified fingerprint equals what lands.
The decisions log guard is enforced by a test and a message, not by prose.
One focused change that keeps the staleness rules as they are.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261106-141829-5g4b left no candidate, no findings and no checks, so nothing from it is kept or fixed. Every file its candidate would have changed is relisted as a deliverable, and the work is redone from the base.

Code survey: I read crates/athena-core/src/land.rs (Plan::Stale, the verified-fingerprint match), crates/athena-core/src/run/close.rs (stale handling at close), crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (retry eligibility), crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (the retry command and its help), crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs (the log guard) and crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs. The entry point is `athena retry`: it validates the job state, then builds a proposal. For a stale job it will merge first, then run checks, replay and verification, then land. The change adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are unaffected. Fingerprint equality is measured directly: the fingerprint of the merged tree that was verified is compared with the fingerprint of what lands.
The change adds no refusal rule on readings. It loosens retry. The decisions guard tightening applies to edits of docs/decisions.md only: expected 0% of newly refused readings.
The new decision is appended at the end of docs/decisions.md as the next id after the current highest. It cites D10 and reverses its alternative (d). docs/decision-links.toml is untouched.
defaults.toml, athena.toml and the workflows need no change.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`: a test shows `athena retry` on a stale job returns a proposal rather than an error.

Run `cargo test`: a test where the kept candidate merges cleanly onto a moved branch tip shows checks, replay and verification run on the merged tree, the job lands, and no planner or producer call is recorded for the retry.
Run `cargo test`: a test where the candidate conflicts with the moved tip shows the retry goes to a producer run seeded from the candidate, and nothing lands without a new verification.

Run `cargo test`: a test shows the landed content's fingerprint equals the fingerprint verified on the merged tree. The existing land.rs Plan::Stale tests still pass, so a landing whose verified fingerprint differs is refused.

Run `cargo test`: a decisions.rs test shows the log guard fails with a message containing 'append at end of file' when an entry is inserted before the end of the pinned base, or when a new entry's id is not one greater than the previous highest. It passes on the real docs/decisions.md.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`: all pass.

`git diff -U0 -- docs/decisions.md` shows a single hunk of added lines after the last line of the base file and no changed existing line. The new decision cites D10 by id, says it reverses the left-out alternative (d) 'Automatic re-verification on the new base', and gives the reason that stale landings now recur with parallel jobs.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing only what the diff does, and the README.md text saying stale jobs are refused is corrected.

The retry help text in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs and the stale reader brief in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs no longer call a stale job simply rejected. They state that the retry starts from the base when the candidate cannot be merged, and the brief test covers this.
Only the listed files change, and no secrets or personal data are committed.

out_of_scope: Automatic (drain-triggered) re-verification of stale jobs without an explicit athena retry
Changing the staleness rules in land.rs plan() (what makes a job stale)
Retrying other non-retryable states (landed, dropped, abandoned)
Editing or annotating any existing line of docs/decisions.md or docs/decision-links.toml
Prompt files and governance configuration (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows)
departures: The change touches the retry pipeline, the landing path and the log guard across 14 files, so cost and time are above the reference. The previous attempt also did not reach verification.
hard_reason: It changes the landing path and the retry pipeline for stale jobs, and it adds a check to the decisions log guard, so a mistake could land unverified content.
